Senses.Explanation: The closing turn of Linji's fourfold shine-work formula — shine and work held apart, asking and answering — recited, elaborated, tested, and answered across the records. Linji Yixuan's address to the assembly sets the four turns and their stakes — asking-and-answering with guest and host standing, kneading water and mud, meeting the moment — and the beyond-measure one walks off before it is raised; Jingqing Daofu poses the four sayings himself and answers the apart-turn with yesterday's rain and today's clear sky; Langye Huijue elaborates the old one's formula — shine first bares the lion's claws, work first looses the elephant king's might, together a dragon making rain and cloud, and apart the coaxing of a darling child, the cherishing of a beloved son — then asks whether the gate fits or not, a Jixin mounting the nine-dragon carriage or a Xiangyu losing his thousand-li steed, and who will breathe for Langye; and Tianyin Yuanxiu performs the fourfold live — a shout for shine-first, a shout for work-first, a shout with the staff falling for together, and the apart-turn left for dragon-elephants to tread, beyond any ass's bearing — Linji is coming, and he walks out of the hall. Hanyue Fazang reads the turn through the four shouts — the diamond sword, the crouching lion, the probing pole and shadow grass, the shout that is not a shout — together, fix your eye; apart, ask after the three days before — this is the not-much teaching, and the day he builds the Linji school all present are to strip him; Liao'an Qingyu offers the identifications — shine-first a horned snake, work-first a toothless tiger, together bearing Sumeru with sun and moon across the shoulders, and apart overturning the earth's axis and treading through the gate of heaven — one shout, then the family tune ten-thousand-year glad across the five lakes; Dabian Xianquan recites the whole formula to the assembly and seals it with the old mirror on its stand, the compass out and wolf-smoke ended, the bolt gathered and released, the one moonlight held; and Yulin Tongxiu, after the new Baoyin's shout at the hall, raises the four shouts and the fourfold both and asks which the live strike was — shine-first? work-first? together? apart? — and as the assembly hesitates, whirls the staff and scatters them.
